action.content: Write a 30-line poem with short sentences without any comma. Each line should contain exactly one sentence. Make sure that you put the right punctuation at the end of each line. Your entire response should contain the poem only.
action.label: context

action.content:
The sun rises high above the hill
The birds begin to sing their song
The morning air feels cool and still
A gentle breeze begins to blow
The leaves upon the trees start to move
The shadows stretch across the ground
The world wakes up from its sleep
The sky turns blue and bright
The clouds drift slowly by
The wind whispers through the grass
The flowers open up their heads
The bees fly out to gather nectar
The ants march in a busy line
The river flows with gentle sound
The water sparkles in the light
The fish swim deep below the surface
The waves crash softly on the shore
The tide comes in and goes away
The moon hangs full and round
The stars twinkle in the dark
The night is quiet and calm
The wind stops blowing softly
The world prepares for rest again
The moon sets low behind the trees
The darkness covers everything now
The dream begins to take hold
The heart beats slow and deep
The sleep comes gently and sweet
The morning will come again soon
action.label: response
